# terrakube_policy_attachment (Data Source)

Query a Terrakube OPA Policy Attachment by policy set ID and target scope (workspace_id, project_id, tag_id) or attachment ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy_set_id` (String) Target Policy Set ID

### Optional

- `id` (String) Attachment ID (UUID). Specify either id or a target scope.
- `project_id` (String) Attached Project ID
- `tag_id` (String) Attached Organization Tag ID
- `workspace_id` (String) Attached Workspace ID
